## What's Changed
* chore(deps): update dependency org.slf4j:slf4j-api to v2.0.18 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2498
* chore(deps): update dependency com.ezylang:evalex to v3.6.1 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2426
* chore(deps): update kotlin monorepo to v2.3.21 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2448
* chore(deps): update dependency org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm to v1.11.0 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2489
* chore(deps): update dependency org.springframework:spring-web to v6.2.18 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2425
* Implement CTRF report generation for backward compatibility by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2495
* Alternative 2: Use a separate fully resolved schema for change tracking of refs by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2507
* Mark an operation as changed in the BCC report if it was edited in the new spec by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2505
* Fix BCC change tracking for external refs by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2509
* build: bump specmatic reporter to 0.3.23 by @jaydeepk in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2512
* Add changed qualifier to BCC CTRF operations by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2510
* Update dependency org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-serialization-json-jvm to v1.11.0 by @specmatic-builder in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2408
* Remove compatibility object from BCC CTRF report by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2514
* fix(core): register report config provider by @jaydeepk in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2517
* Support WIP in backward compatibility checks and reports by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2516
* Fix BCC CTRF report dropping all but the last checked spec by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2518
* BCC CTRF rawStatus carries compatible/incompatible by @sahilm in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2519
* Fix stash detection when git stash list is empty by @nashjain in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2522


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.46.1...2.46.2
